summary: New acceptance matrix for the agent-reassignment (bulk + single) feature verified end to end: 2 backend test files (6 tests) covering the reassign-agent API happy path, validation (403/422/404) and the outstanding-follows-the-agent guarantee; 3 new browser checks covering the Policy MIS bulk-reassign flow, the single-policy detail reassign + history entry, and the Upload page agent-confirmation text. All fixtures (tscheck-prefixed throwaway agents + directly-inserted Mongo policy docs) were created and fully cleaned up; DB verified back to exactly 1 user (kumararaja, must_change_password=true, password Raja@1985) and 0 policies at the end, matching the seed_facts/spec_deviations cleanup requirement.
action_items: note: test_outstanding_moves_with_agent_on_reassign (in test_tscheck_reassign_outstanding_follows.py) errored once with a 500 on POST /api/users when run concurrently with test_tscheck_reassign_agent_validation.py under pytest.ini's fixed -n2/--dist loadscope (two workers both generating the next sequential agtNNNN username at the same instant -> Mongo unique-index collision on users.username). This is a pre-existing sequential-username-generation race under parallel test execution, not a defect in the reassign feature itself; both files pass cleanly together on rerun (6/6) and were run together 2 more times with no further collision -- classified as flaky, not a bug. No action needed unless the main agent wants username generation made collision-safe under -n2.

note: the bulk-reassign browser check's first attempt against the public preview URL failed on a bad locator (page.getByText('tscheck-browser-agentB').first() ambiguously matched the already-rendered table cell instead of the open dropdown option, intercepted by a portal overlay) -- fixed by switching to page.getByRole('option', {name: ...}); not an application bug, cross-checked by the backend log showing healthy 200s throughout. Fixed script now passes on both localhost and https://insurance-mis-portal.preview.emergentagent.com.

checks.criterion: User bug: policies uploaded under the wrong agent -- admin/backoffice must be able to bulk-correct the agent of existing policies via the Policy MIS list
checks.name: bulk-reassign-agent-in-policies-list
checks.evidence: Logged in as kumararaja (admin). /policies search for 'tscheck-bulk-pol' showed 2 fixture rows under agent tscheck-browser-agentA. policies-select-all -> policies-selection-bar appeared. bulk-reassign-agent-select -> picked tscheck-browser-agentB option -> bulk-reassign-agent-apply-button -> toast 'moved to tscheck-browser-agentB · AGT1002' visible. Both rows' Agent column now show tscheck-browser-agentB and 0 rows still show agentA. Re-verified through https://insurance-mis-portal.preview.emergentagent.com after a locator fix -- passed there too.

checks.criterion: Single policy agent correction on detail page
checks.name: single-policy-reassign-agent-on-detail
checks.evidence: Opened fixture policy tscheck-detail-pol-1 (under agentA). policy-agent-label initially showed tscheck-browser-agentA. Used policy-reassign-agent-select to pick tscheck-browser-agentD, clicked policy-reassign-agent-apply-button -> success toast; policy-agent-label updated to tscheck-browser-agentD / AGT1003; history list shows an 'Agent changed' entry with note containing 'tscheck-browser-agentA ... -> ... tscheck-browser-agentD'.

checks.name: test_tscheck_reassign_outstanding_follows.py
checks.evidence: Inserted Cash policy (gross_premium=20655) under agent A directly into Mongo. GET /api/outstanding -> agent A row outstanding=20655, no row for agent B. POST /api/policies/reassign-agent {policy_ids:[pid], agent_id:B} -> 200. GET /api/outstanding again -> agent A has no row (None), agent B row outstanding=20655. Fixtures (2 agents + 1 policy) deleted in a finally-block.

checks.name: test_tscheck_reassign_agent_validation.py
checks.evidence: 5 tests: bulk happy path POST /policies/reassign-agent {2 policy_ids, agent_id:B} -> 200 {updated:2, agent_code:B}, both policies' agent_id/agent_code updated and history has 'Agent changed' with old/new codes. Unknown agent_id -> 403 'Agent is outside your assigned scope'. Agent role calling the endpoint -> 403. Empty policy_ids [] -> 422 (Pydantic min_length=1). Unknown policy id -> 404. All via real HTTP against localhost:8001; fixtures cleaned up in finally-block.

checks.name: upload-page-confirms-selected-agent
checks.evidence: On /upload as admin, selected tscheck-browser-agentD in upload-agent-select; upload-agent-confirm became visible with text 'Uploading for tscheck-browser-agentD · AGT1003 -- check before dropping files.'
